# STRAIGHT POWER 11

## World class quiet and efficiency

The be quiet! Straight Power 11 PSU series provides a new level of silent performance for systems that demand whisper-quiet operation without the slightest compromise in power quality. The 80 PLUS® Gold label proofs the focus on efficiency of this latest generation of the Straight Power series. These all go to make the Straight Power 11 series more silent and efficient than ever and clearly the best choice when building new systems or as an upgrade to existing systems.

### Straight Power 11

- 750W
- 850W
- 1000W

Series comparison PSU calculator

## Features

#### World-class Efficient and Power-Saving Operation

- Standby drain of less than 0.16 Watts
- Innovative, wire-free design on the DC side inside the PSU body results in better cooling airflow, less signal disturbance and longer component life spans
- 80 PLUS® Gold certification with an extremely high operating efficiency of up to 93,6%

#### Virtually Inaudible Operation

- The fan speed is optimally varied to strike the best balance between sufficient cooling and deep quietness
- The Silent Wings fan is decoupled from the PSU body with a special mounting, further reducing the transmission of vibration and noise
- Funnel-shaped fan opening of the PSU case is relatively large and this permits a high airflow intake
- The Silent Wings 135mm fan features an advanced fan frame, airflow-optimized fan blades, fluid-dynamic bearing and a high-quality 6-pole motor for minimal vibration

#### Very High Power Conversion, Performance and Stability

- 4 independent 12V-rails for improved power signal stability
- Full suite of top safety protections that guard against over-currents, over and under voltages, short circuits, overheating and overloads, thus safeguarding your valuable components
- High-quality Japanese capacitors rated to 105°C for maximum performance, reliability and operating life
- LLC, Synchronous Rectifier (SR) and DC-to-DC power conversion technology for advanced stability and tight voltage regulation

#### Excellent Compatibility and Easy Usage

- multi-GPU support with up to 6 PCIe connectors
- Sleeved cables with lengths of up to 115cm are perfect for large PC cases
- Convenient full cable management for maximum build flexibility, reduced clutter, improved airflow and better cooling

#### Outstanding Service and Support

- Product conception, design and quality control in Germany
- 5-year manufacturer's warranty

### Legendary Silence, Cutting Edge Performance

Dark Power Pro 11 1200W is be quiet!’s most advanced PSU ever. With 1200W of continuously available power and an overclocking key that switches between four-rail and single-rail operation, it has sufficient reserves to support any multi-GPU or multi-CPU system you could want to build. be quiet!’s virtually inaudible Silent Wings 3 fan and an unparalleled array of noise-reducing enhancements make it the quietest PSU in its category, perfect for powerful applications that nevertheless need significant quietness.
